text: Success in manufacture is based solely upon an ability to serve that consumer to his liking. He may be served by quality or he may be served by price. He is best served by the highest quality at the lowest price, and any man who can give to the consumer the highest quality at the lowest price is bound to be a leader in business.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter IX, Why Not Always Have Good Business?
